fixes.explanation: I can see that guess, friend, but break isn't the word. The verse says, "Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?" (Ecclesiastes 7:13) The Teacher isn't asking who can wreck God's work. He's asking who can fix what God has bent, and that's a different point. Tell me you wouldn't hold a bent spoon and think, 'Time to smash it.' You'd look for the straightening part.

Not this time, baker. The verse says, "Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?" (Ecclesiastes 7:13) Hiding sounds sneaky, like shoving a crooked cookie to the back of the tray and hoping nobody notices. But the Teacher isn't asking who can cover it up. He's asking who can straighten it, and that's the word that fits.
